tools.name: pulseway_get_environment
tools.description: Show the Pulseway instance behind this token: customer name, server type (SaaS or On-Prem), product version, language and license dates. Pulseway API: GET /v3/environment.

tools.name: pulseway_get_rate_limits
tools.description: Show the remaining requests for this token per endpoint and the failed-request limits per IP address. Use it before a large batch of calls. Pulseway API: GET /v3/ratelimits.

tools.name: pulseway_list_devices
tools.description: List devices (computers and servers) with their group, site and organization. Filter with OData $filter on Identifier or Name. Pulseway API: GET /v3/devices.

tools.name: pulseway_get_device
tools.description: Show one device: name, group, site, organization and agent state. Pulseway API: GET /v3/devices/{identifier}.

tools.name: pulseway_get_device_antivirus
tools.description: Show the antivirus state of one device: protection, definitions and scan status. Pulseway API: GET /v3/devices/{identifier}/antivirus.

tools.name: pulseway_list_device_notifications
tools.description: List the notifications (alerts) raised for one device. Filter on Id, Message, DateTime or Priority. Pulseway API: GET /v3/devices/{identifier}/notifications.

tools.name: pulseway_list_notifications
tools.description: List notifications across all devices. Filter on Id, Message, DateTime or Priority. Pulseway API: GET /v3/notifications.

tools.name: pulseway_list_assets
tools.description: List assets (hardware and software inventory records) with their group and description. Filter on Identifier, Name, GroupName or Description. Pulseway API: GET /v3/assets.

tools.name: pulseway_list_organizations
tools.description: List organizations (customers of the MSP). Pulseway API: GET /v3/organizations.

tools.name: pulseway_list_sites
tools.description: List sites (locations within an organization). Pulseway API: GET /v3/sites.

tools.name: pulseway_list_groups
tools.description: List groups (device groups within a site). Pulseway API: GET /v3/groups.

tools.name: pulseway_list_scripts
tools.description: List the automation scripts that can run on devices, with their id, name and input variables. Pulseway API: GET /v3/automation/scripts.

tools.name: pulseway_get_script_executions
tools.description: List the past runs of one script on one device, with state and times. Pulseway API: GET /v3/automation/scripts/{scriptId}/device/{deviceId}/executions.

tools.name: pulseway_list_workflows
tools.description: List the automation workflows in this instance, with their trigger type. Pulseway API: GET /v3/automation/workflows.

tools.name: pulseway_run_script
tools.description: WRITE ACTION: runs one automation script on ONE device. The device must be online. Each call starts a new run. After an error, check pulseway_get_script_executions for the device before any second call. Pulseway API: POST /v3/automation/scripts/{scriptId}/run.

tools.name: pulseway_list_audit_logs
tools.description: List audit log entries: who did what in Pulseway and when. Filter on the audit fields, e.g. EventDescription or AuditLogRecordDateTime. Pulseway API: GET /v3/auditlogs.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pulseway_list_device_notifications, pulseway_list_notifications, pulseway_run_script · Private data: pulseway_get_environment, pulseway_get_rate_limits, pulseway_list_assets · Public sink: pulseway_run_script · Destructive: pulseway_list_scripts, pulseway_run_script.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pulseway_list_device_notifications, pulseway_list_notifications, pulseway_run_script · Private data: pulseway_get_environment, pulseway_get_rate_limits, pulseway_list_assets · Public sink: pulseway_run_script · Destructive: pulseway_list_scripts, pulseway_run_script

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
